A '''communications tower''' was a structure that could be located atop the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="EGTVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
